einzeiler: Emma Woodhouse navigates matchmaking, secrets, and misunderstandings before finding true…
kurzfassung: Emma Woodhouse, a clever and self-satisfied young woman in high society, fancies herself a matchmaker with disastrous results. Through a series of romantic misunderstandings involving her friends and acquaintances, she finally confronts her own flaws and feelings. Ultimately, she realizes her true love for Mr. Knightley, leading to a joyful resolution for everyone involved.
stichpunkte: Emma tries to arrange matches for Harriet Smith, mistakenly believing Mr. Elton is in love with her.
Frank Churchill arrives in Highbury, sparking rumors and a secret engagement with Jane Fairfax.
Tensions rise during social gatherings, notably at Box Hill where Emma thoughtlessly insults Miss Bates.
Emma discovers that Harriet has developed feelings for Mr. Knightley, forcing Emma to examine her own heart.
Mr. Knightley confesses his love for Emma, revealing she has always held his heart.
Secret engagements and misunderstandings are finally cleared up, paving the way for multiple weddings.

clips.hook: Traveling long distances with a four-horse carriage
clips.text: Mrs. Elton boasts about her brother-in-law's wealth and their frequent long-distance journeys made with a four-horse carriage.

clips.hook: A charade where two letters spell perfection
clips.text: Mr. Weston proposes a simple charade where the first two parts are letters of the alphabet and the whole expression denotes perfection.

clips.hook: Swear on what is most sacred to hide nothing
clips.text: Emma frantically demands that Mr. Weston swear on what is most sacred to tell her the absolute truth about a perceived crisis.

beschreibung:
Emma, "belle, intelligente et riche" a une fâcheuse tendance a vouloir marier les autres. Ce qu'elle va d'abord faire pour sa sœur, puis sa gouvernante, miss Taylor. Mais la voilà seule, avec son père âgé, veuf et très craintif, voir hypocondriaque. Son ami, M. Knightley essaie de la raisonner en l'empêchant d'avoir cette manie de marier ses proches. Pourtant, ses plans semblent relativement bien fonctionner. Qui sera donc sa prochaine protégée ? Et elle, songera-t-elle à se marier un jour ? - Summary by Laurette
Genre(s): Literary Fiction, Romance
Language: French
